instruction: Candid dance photograph, full shot. Inside a bright, minimalist ballet studio with white walls and large windows, the female dancer in a black long-sleeve top and white tutu (R1) spins dynamically on one leg in the center-left. The male dancer in a black unitard (R2) stands closely behind her, supporting her movement with arms extended as they hold hands. Both dancers maintain focused expressions during the routine. Soft, natural daylight streams through the windows, illuminating the wooden floor and creating a neutral color palette with gentle shadows.
